nodes.short_description:
Tek amacın her şeyi yerle bir etmek olduğu o VR oyunu.
Kompakt ve fiziksel bir VR deneyimi olarak tasarlanan I’m Having A Bad Day, oldukça basit bir fikir üzerine kurulmuş çizgi film (cartoon) tarzında bir oyundur: Şeyleri kırıp dökmek sadece eğlencelidir.

在這款VR遊戲中，砸碎一切就是全部的意義。
作為一款緊湊且注重肢體動作的VR體驗，《I'm Having A Bad Day》是一款圍繞簡單理念打造的卡通風格遊戲：破壞也可以充滿樂趣。

VR-peli, jossa kaiken pirstominen on koko homman ydin.
Kompaktiksi ja fyysiseksi VR-kokemukseksi luotu I'm Having A Bad Day on sarjakuvatyylinen peli, joka on rakennettu yksinkertaisen idean ympärille: asioiden rikkominen voi olla hauskaa.

Le jeu en VR où tout casser est le seul et unique but.
Conçu comme une expérience VR physique et compacte, I’m Having A Bad Day est un jeu au style cartoon basé sur une idée toute simple : casser des trucs, c'est fun.

VR-spillet, hvor det er hele pointen at smadre alt.
I'm Having A Bad Day er skabt som en kompakt og fysisk VR-oplevelse og er et spil i animationsstil bygget op omkring en enkel idé: Det kan være sjovt at ødelægge ting.

VR-игра, в которой единственная цель - сломать все.
Разработанная как компактный и динамичный VR-опыт, I’m Having A Bad Day - это яркая игра, построенная вокруг идеи, что рушить и ломать - весело.

VR-spelet där det enda målet är att slå sönder allt.
I’m Having A Bad Day är skapat som en kompakt och fysisk VR-upplevelse – ett spel i tecknad stil som bygger på en enkel idé: Det är helt enkelt sjukt kul att förstöra saker.

눈앞의 모든 것을 박살 내는 스트레스 해소용 VR 게임!

가볍게 즐길 수 있는 역동적인 VR 경험으로 탄생한 『오늘은 운이 없네』(I’m Having A Bad Day)는 “무언가를 부수는 건 정말 즐겁다”라는 단순한 아이디어에서 시작된 카툰 스타일의 파괴 액션 게임입니다.

nodes.long_description:
Created as a compact and physical VR experience, **I’m Having a Bad Day** is a cartoon-style game built around a simple idea: breaking things can be fun.

# THE SHOW
You play as a contestant in a fictional reality show set across different environments. The goal is simple: smash, dismantle, and create as much controlled chaos as possible within a short time limit.
{1356244243050499}

# PHYSICS SIMULATION
Objects react with exaggerated cartoon physics and clear visual feedback. Power-ups, such as oversized tools or jelly weapons, temporarily shift the pace and encourage different approaches to destruction.
{2493251997780164}

# ENERGY & FUN
While the game is not designed as a fitness experience, you may find that after demolishing a couple of environments you feel unexpectedly energized especially after a long or stressful day.
{2051986745756148}

**I’m Having a Bad Day** is a straightforward, physics-driven VR game built around short bursts of action and repeatable levels, created for players who enjoy quick sessions and physical interaction in virtual space.
nodes.short_description: Smash your stress away in I’m Having a Bad Day, a fast-paced cartoon VR experience where you compete in a chaotic reality show. Break, dismantle and unleash exaggerated physics-driven destruction in short, intense levels. Easy to jump into, hard to stop, perfect for quick sessions and surprisingly energizing fun.
